name: Tagge prototype battle droid
description: The Tagge prototype battle droid, or prototype Tagge battle droid, was a prototype battle droid model designed by Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra was sent by Tagge to investigate a series of droid malfunctions and encountered the battle droids Tagge had designed.
